  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  map_lie' {_ _} := rfl

open scoped TensorProduct

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def LieHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def actionTensorCAlg' :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

instance : Module ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯ := inferInstance
instance : Module ℂ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ), ℂ⟯ := sorry

def Alg := UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
instance : Semiring (Alg G E) := inferInstanceAs (Semiring (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ..))
instance : Algebra ℂ (Alg G E) := inferInstanceAs (Algebra ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ..))

def Z := Subalgebra.center ℂ (Alg G E)
instance : CommSemiring (Z G E) := inferInstanceAs (CommSemiring (Subalgebra.center ..))
instance : AddCommMonoid (Z G E) := inferInstanceAs (AddCommMonoid (Subalgebra.center ..))

structure IsSmooth (f : GL (Fin n) (FiniteAdeleRing ℤ ℚ) × GL (Fin n) ℝ → ℂ) : Prop where
  continuous : Continuous f
  loc_cst (y : GL (Fin n) ℝ) :
    IsLocallyConstant (fun x ↦ f (x, y))
  smooth (x : GL (Fin n) (FiniteAdeleRing ℤ ℚ)) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ∞ (fun y ↦ f (x, y))

noncomputable abbrev s (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (M * M.transpose).trace + (M⁻¹ * M⁻¹.transpose).trace

structure IsSlowlyIncreasing (f : GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℂ) : Prop where
  bounded_by : ∃ (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
    ∀ (M : GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) ℝ),
    ‖f M‖ ≤ C * (s (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) ^ N

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def LieHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def actionTensorCAlg' :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

instance : Module ℂ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ), ℂ⟯ := sorry

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

  toFun l := Derivation.toLinearMap l
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  map_lie' {_ _} := rfl

open scoped TensorProduct

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def LieHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def actionTensorCAlg' :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

instance : Module ℂ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ), ℂ⟯ := sorry

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where

@[simps!]
def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def actionTensorCAlg' :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def LieHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def actionTensorCAlg' :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

instance : Module ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯ := inferInstance
instance : Module ℂ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ), ℂ⟯ := sorry

@[simps!]
def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def action :
    LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℝ⁆ (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯) where
  toFun l := Derivation.toLinearMap l
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  map_lie' {_ _} := rfl

open scoped TensorProduct

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def LieHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def actionTensorCAlg' :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

instance : Module ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯ := inferInstance
instance : Module ℂ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ), ℂ⟯ := sorry

def Alg := UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
instance : Semiring (Alg G E) := inferInstanceAs (Semiring (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ..))
instance : Algebra ℂ (Alg G E) := inferInstanceAs (Algebra ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ..))

def Z := Subalgebra.center ℂ (Alg G E)
instance : CommSemiring (Z G E) := inferInstanceAs (CommSemiring (Subalgebra.center ..))
instance : AddCommMonoid (Z G E) := inferInstanceAs (AddCommMonoid (Subalgebra.center ..))

def actionTensorCAlg'3 : Z G E →ₐ[ℂ] Module.End ℂ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ), ℂ⟯ := sorry

  continuous : Continuous f
  loc_cst (y : GL (Fin n) ℝ) :

  smooth (x : GL (Fin n) (FiniteAdeleRing ℤ ℚ)) :

  bounded_by : ∃ (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ),

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all

  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by

    intro x m

    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]

    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y

  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)

        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on

        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all

    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by

    intro x m

    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}

    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)

        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m

  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0

  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr

  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

instance : Module ℂ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ), ℂ⟯ := sorry

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def actionTensorCAlg' :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

instance : Module ℂ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ), ℂ⟯ := sorry

theorem diamond_fix :

  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this

  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

import Mathlib.Algebra.Lie.BaseChange

/-!

# The Global Langlands Conjectures for GL(n) over the rationals.

## First sub-goal: definition of an automorphic form.

I've made the design decision of working with the functor
`Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n)` as our implementation
of the `GL_n` functor. There's notation `GL (Fin n)` for this.

-/

open scoped Manifold
/- Next line is necessary while the manifold smoothness class is not extended to `ω`.
Later, replace with `open scoped ContDiff`. -/
local notation "∞" => (⊤ : ℕ∞)

namespace DedekindDomain

open scoped algebraMap

section PRs

open IsDedekindDomain

variable (R K : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] [Field K] [Algebra R K]
  [IsFractionRing R K] (v : HeightOneSpectrum R)

local notation "K_hat" => ProdAdicCompletions
local notation "R_hat" => FiniteIntegralAdeles

section PR13705

namespace ProdAdicCompletions.IsFiniteAdele

open IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum

@[simp]
lemma mem_FiniteAdeleRing (x : K_hat R K) : x ∈ (
    { carrier := {x : K_hat R K | x.IsFiniteAdele}
      mul_mem' := mul
      one_mem' := one
      add_mem' := add
      zero_mem' := zero
      algebraMap_mem' := algebraMap'
    } : Subalgebra K (K_hat R K)) ↔ {v | x v ∉ adicCompletionIntegers K v}.Finite := Iff.rfl

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def actionTensorCAlg' :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

  toFun l := Derivation.toLinearMap l
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

  toFun l := Derivation.toLinearMap l
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  map_lie' {_ _} := rfl

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp

      · simp

variable (R A L M B : Type*)

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)

        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m

  map_lie' := by

    intro x m

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=

  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

  ∀ x, ContMDiffAt I I' n f x

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this

    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=

    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)

    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

@[simps!]
def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def LieHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def actionTensorC :
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

def actionTensorCAlg :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) := by
  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def actionTensorCAlg' :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)

instance : Module ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯ := inferInstance
instance : Module ℂ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ), ℂ⟯ := sorry

/-- `inferInstanceAs α` synthesizes a value of any target type by typeclass
inference. This is just like `inferInstance` except that `α` is given
explicitly instead of being inferred from the target type. It is especially
useful when the target type is some `α'` which is definitionally equal to `α`,
but the instance we are looking for is only registered for `α` (because
typeclass search does not unfold most definitions, but definitional equality
does.) Example:
```
#check inferInstanceAs (Inhabited Nat) -- Inhabited Nat
```
-/

  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on

      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

  ext x y

  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

variable (n : ℕ) (G : Type) [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

informal_statement: Given a commutative semiring $R$, and modules $M$ and $N$ over $R$, the annihilator of an element $a \in M$ is a submodule of the space of linear maps from $M$ to $N$, consisting precisely of those linear maps that send $a$ to zero.
informal_proof:
Let $R$ be a commutative semiring, and let $M$ and $N$ be modules over $R$. For an element $a \in M$, the annihilator of $a$, denoted $\text{Ann}(a)$, is defined as the set of all linear maps $f: M \to N$ such that $f(a) = 0$. We aim to show that $\text{Ann}(a)$ is a submodule of $\text{Hom}_R(M, N)$, the space of all linear maps from $M$ to $N$.

To prove this, we need to verify two properties: that $\text{Ann}(a)$ is closed under addition and scalar multiplication, and that it contains the zero map.

1. **Closure under Addition**: Let $f, g \in \text{Ann}(a)$. Then, $f(a) = 0$ and $g(a) = 0$. Consider $(f + g)(a) = f(a) + g(a) = 0 + 0 = 0$. Thus, $f + g \in \text{Ann}(a)$.

2. **Closure under Scalar Multiplication**: Let $f \in \text{Ann}(a)$ and $r \in R$. Then, $f(a) = 0$. Consider $(r \cdot f)(a) = r \cdot f(a) = r \cdot 0 = 0$. Thus, $r \cdot f \in \text{Ann}(a)$.

3. ** contains the zero map**: The zero map $0: M \to N$ defined by $0(m) = 0_N$ for all $m \in M$ satisfies $0(a) = 0_N$. Hence, $0 \in \text{Ann}(a)$.

Since $\text{Ann}(a)$ satisfies all submodule criteria, it is a submodule of $\text{Hom}_R(M, N)$.

def bracketBilin (R L M) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M] :
    L →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ _ (Bracket.bracket)
    add_lie smul_lie lie_add lie_smul

attribute [ext] Bracket

open scoped TensorProduct

noncomputable instance instLieAlgebra'
  (S R A L : Type*) [CommRing S] [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [Algebra S A] [SMulCommClass R S A] :
    LieAlgebra S (A ⊗[R] L) where
  lie_smul a x y := by
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on generalizing y
    · simp
    · induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on
      · simp
      · simp [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      · simp_all
    · simp_all [add_lie]

variable (R A L M B : Type*)
variable [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]

theorem diamond_fix :
    LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instBracketTensorProduct R A B B = Ring.instBracket := by
  ext x y
  conv_lhs => rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ _]
  rw [← @bracketBilin_apply_apply R _ _ _ (_) (.ofAssociativeAlgebra) _ _ (_) (_) x y]
  rotate_left
  exact @lieAlgebraSelfModule ..
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ ?_ x y
  ext xa xb ya yb
  change @Bracket.bracket _ _ _ (xa ⊗ₜ[R] xb) (ya ⊗ₜ[R] yb) = _
  dsimp [Ring.lie_def]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, mul_comm]

end

  toFun l := Derivation.toLinearMap l
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  map_lie' {_ _} := rfl

open scoped TensorProduct

def LieModuleHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule R L M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [LieRingModule L N] [LieModule R L N]
    (f : M →ₗ⁅R, L⁆ N) : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ⁅A, A ⊗[R] L⁆ A ⊗[R] N where
      __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] M →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] N)
      map_lie' := by
        simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
        intro x m
        induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
        · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
        · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
        · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

def LieHom.baseChange
    (A : Type*) {R L L' : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]
    [LieRing L'] [LieAlgebra R L']
    (f : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L') : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ⁅A⁆ A ⊗[R] L' where
  __ := (LinearMap.baseChange A f : A ⊗[R] L →ₗ[A] A ⊗[R] L')
  map_lie' := by
    simp only [AddHom.toFun_eq_coe, LinearMap.coe_toAddHom]
    intro x m
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on
    · simp only [zero_lie, map_zero]
    · induction m using TensorProduct.induction_on <;> simp_all
    · simp_all only [add_lie, map_add]

    ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯)) :=
  LieHom.baseChange _ (action _ _)

  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]

  have := actionTensorC G E; revert this
  convert ⇑(UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift ℂ
    (L := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)
    (A := ℂ ⊗[ℝ] (Module.End ℝ C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; ℝ⟯))) using 0
  congr!
  · dsimp [LieAlgebra.ExtendScalars.instLieRing, LieRing.ofAssociativeRing]; congr
    apply diamond_fix
  · change HEq ({..} : LieAlgebra ..) (@LieAlgebra.mk _ _ _ (_) _ _); congr!

def actionTensorCAlg' :
  UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (LinearMap.tensorProductEnd ..).comp (actionTensorCAlg G E)

def actionTensorCAlg'2 :
  Subalgebra.center ℂ (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] LeftInvariantDerivation 𝓘(ℝ, E) G)) →ₐ[ℂ]
    Module.End ℂ (ℂ ⊗[ℝ] C^∞⟮𝓘(ℝ, E), G; 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ), ℝ⟯) :=
  (actionTensorCAlg' G E).comp (SubalgebraClass.val _)
